propositions: The autodeploy no-op tick (every ~2 min during main quiescence) does not call prune_docker_caches(), leaving root disk unclaimed between deploys and causing prolonged CloudWatch alarm.

prune_docker_caches() is currently defined after the no-op early-exit line (228), making it inaccessible if called from that location; it must be relocated above line 150 to be callable before line 228.

A pressure-triggered, throttled reclaim helper (reclaim_under_pressure) should fire on the no-op path when root disk usage exceeds DISK_PRESSURE_PCT (default 80%) and the last prune was more than PRESSURE_PRUNE_MIN_INTERVAL (default 600s) ago.
Prune failures on the pressure path must not alter autodeploy's exit code and must only log, consistent with existing deploy-path behavior.

An AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE marker must be emitted to stderr exactly once per triggered pressure prune for observability and must not appear when the threshold is unmet or the throttle window is active.
